item.title: Describe a Sound for a Class Project
item.prompt_text: Your class is collecting sounds from everyday places. Choose an ordinary sound that people can listen to for just a few seconds. Describe where and when you hear it, what the sound is like, and why it belongs in the collection. Invent an example if you want.
item.audience: classmates making a short sound collection
item.target_grammar: Present simple for a regular sound, when for its context, and because for a reason.
item.target_structure: Name the sound, locate it, then explain what it can tell a listener.

checklist.point: Locate the sound in a real or imagined place.
Describe the sound or its rhythm.
Explain why the collection should include it.
